claimChecks.claim: 20–60% region is a fixed operative sling target and establishes one reflex-closure mechanism
claimChecks.note: Study percentages are approximate anatomy, not patient-specific operative cutoffs or proof of a single mechanism.

claimChecks.claim: Each MUCP component is one-third in all women; birth causes universal 25% loss; 60–100 is a normal cutoff
claimChecks.locator: Publisher abstract: five-woman estimate, group comparisons and longitudinal birth caveat
claimChecks.note: Numbers now population-scoped; fixed normal cutoff removed. Original underlying studies remain unread.

claimChecks.claim: Estrogen treats all SUI and Burch is only suited to concurrent laparotomy
claimChecks.locator: EAU §4.2.4.b.1 and §4.2.4.c.2.a; prior Burch source report
claimChecks.note: Estrogen recommendation applies with atrophy symptoms; open or laparoscopic colposuspension remains a counseled option.

claimChecks.claim: All diverticulectomy and urethrovaginal fistula repairs require a Martius/interposition flap
claimChecks.note: Flaps are selected by defect/tissue; evidence for universal Martius use is lacking.

claimChecks.note: Counsel by symptomatic/occult status and added adverse events; no surgery if neither symptomatic nor occult SUI at abdominal repair.
